DECLARE @sql nvarchar(MAX)
DECLARE @schemaname as varchar(50) = 'DW'
DECLARE @tblname as varchar(50) = 'DimRiskRatingType'
DECLARE @colname as varchar(50)
DECLARE @datatype as varchar(20)
DECLARE @isnullable as varchar(5)
DECLARE @ordinalposition VARCHAR(3)
DECLARE @counter int = 1
DECLARE @recordCount int = (SELECT COUNT(COLUMN_NAME) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = @schemaname AND TABLE_NAME = @tblname)

CREATE TABLE  #MyTableVar (
    [TABLE_SCHEMA] varchar(60),
    [TABLE_NAME] varchar(60),
    [COLUMN_NAME] varchar(50),
    [ORDINAL POSITION] int,
    [DATA_TYPE] varchar(20),
    [IS_NULLABLE] varchar(5),
    [NON NULL] bigint,
    [NULL] bigint,
    [UNIQUE] bigint,
    [DISTINCT] bigint,
    [MIN] nvarchar(2048),
    [MAX] nvarchar(2048)
    
)


WHILE @counter <= @recordCount 
BEGIN  

SELECT @colname = COLUMN_NAME, @datatype = DATA_TYPE, @isnullable = IS_NULLABLE, @ordinalposition = ORDINAL_POSITION  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = @schemaname AND TABLE_NAME = @tblname AND Ordinal_position = @counter


SET @sql = 'WITH CTE AS (SELECT ' + @colname + ' FROM ' + @schemaname + '.' + @tblname + ' GROUP BY ' + @colname + ' HAVING COUNT(1) = 1) 


INSERT INTO #MyTableVar ([TABLE_SCHEMA], [TABLE_NAME], [COLUMN_NAME], [ORDINAL POSITION], [DATA_TYPE], [IS_NULLABLE], [NON NULL], [NULL], [UNIQUE], [DISTINCT], [MIN], [MAX])
SELECT '''+ @schemaname + ''','''+ @tblname + ''',''' + @colname + ''',''' + @ordinalposition + ''',''' + @datatype + ''', ''' + @isnullable + ''',

(SELECT COUNT(' + @colname + ') FROM ' + @schemaname + '.' + @tblname + ' WHERE ' + @colname + ' IS NOT NULL) [NON NULL],
(SELECT COUNT(' + @colname + ') FROM ' + @schemaname + '.' + @tblname + ' WHERE ' + @colname + ' IS NULL) [NULL], 
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CTE) [UNIQUE],
COUNT(DISTINCT ' + @colname + ') [DISTINCT],
CAST(MIN(' + @colname + ') AS nvarchar(2048)) [MIN],  
CAST(MAX(' + @colname + ') AS nvarchar(2048)) [MAX]
FROM ' + @schemaname + '.' + @tblname


EXEC (@sql)
SET @counter = @counter + 1
END

SELECT [TABLE_SCHEMA], [TABLE_NAME], [COLUMN_NAME], [ORDINAL POSITION], [DATA_TYPE], [IS_NULLABLE], [NON NULL], [NULL], [UNIQUE], [DISTINCT], [MIN], [MAX]  FROM #MyTableVar ORDER BY [ORDINAL POSITION]
